title: Escalation
description: The HITL work item (0012 §1): staged by machine, decided by humans. Machine speed for detection; human judgment for consequence (0013 §7). Everything here runs on WALL-CLOCK — locks rust at physical speed (0004 §1). Silence never approves: expiry is denial, and a vigil signal (locked 2026-07-02).

action.description: The staged act, opaque to the queue — executed only after quorum + cooling-off.

staged_by.description: vigil, a steward, a gateway, or a human — staging is free; deciding is gated.

evidence.description: Signed record refs — the case for the action, Sourced + Verified.

expires_at.description: Past this, the escalation is DENIED (default-deny) and vigil is signaled. Re-staging needs fresh evidence.

by.description: A control-entitled human principal — distinct per approval; no DID signs twice.

approved_at.description: When quorum completed — cooling-off counts from here.

GateRule.description: One row of a GatePolicy (0012 §2). Gate policies cascade TIGHTEN-ONLY like floors: a child may raise co_signs, lengthen cooling_off, or shorten ttl — never the reverse. Locked 2026-07-02: bars are ABSOLUTE — if fewer entitled humans exist than co_signs requires, the action is structurally unavailable (no clamping, no bootstrap exception).

legal_signoff.description: e.g. produce-keys under lawful process: 3 + legal (0013 §6).

cooling_off.description: Approved-but-held: the abort window between quorum and execution (destroy, floor-loosen).

ttl.description: Wall-clock life of a pending escalation before default-deny.
